rejected_or_limited_leads.claim: hedwigai independently reproduced full MATH-500 thinking-on at 48.1%
rejected_or_limited_leads.correction: 48.1% is explicitly the authors' reference. Hedwig reports first-100-problem checks at 12% base/51% edited with one answer per problem (n=100). This is a subset, not a full MATH-500 rerun; the exact token cap for this check is not established in that passage.
